_README.additions: all new articles should be added at the TOP of the articles array
_README.date-format: Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD or optionally YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS
_README.image-path: all image paths must be relative, which will mean every path will be ../../assets/images/name-of-image.extension
_README.types: the type property will be used to filter articles on the news.html page (press-release, game-summary)
